checks.evidence: Binding authenticator when account and authenticator AALs are equal, step 1-2: account with max AAL2, new AAL2 authenticator, system prompts for AAL2 authentication before binding.
Binding authenticator with insufficient authentication level, step 2: AAL1-only credentials provided, authentication fails and the new authenticator is not bound.

invented: Account with max AAL1 can bind an AAL2 authenticator after only AAL1 authentication (test 1 asserts the binding succeeds, which is assumed rather than stated)
Test 2 expects AAL1 authentication to suffice for binding an AAL1 authenticator to an AAL2 account
